body:
What version of Angular?

And is there any chance you could provide a reproduction via [jsbin](http://jsbin.com/), [plnkr.co](http://plnkr.co), or [jsfiddle](http://jsfiddle.net/)?

This would be helpful in verifying the bug. Thanks!

I couldn't get my example to work on plnkr but a the simplest example I could come up with is here:

https://gist.github.com/Zyzle/7413efdf86e6fc7c0bfe

**Edit:** additionally if you remove the `<base>` tag from the html file you'll be able to reproduce the issue raised here #3096
I suspect that the problem is that `Router` calls `pushState` again after a navigation resulting from a popState event.
@btford I'll take over this issue since the issue was shortlisted in your email last week.

issue.title: fix(router): ensure navigation via back button works

accordingly whenever a popState event is handled.

Closes #2201
